proposal_text: Gate-loop on qor-plan: Phases 15 (G12) and 16 (G13) each needed repeated plan iterations and escalation overrides. Every VETO was a valid, distinct long-tail phrasing defect; the rules are heuristic text classifiers whose defect space is open-ended, so adversarial plan audits do not converge on their own. Proposed process change: for heuristic text-rule phases, the plan names a frozen acceptance corpus plus a stated residual-risk budget up front; the audit may VETO only for (a) contract/consistency defects or (b) a counterexample class the auditor shows is common and that the Governor then adds to the corpus. Further long-tail cases are recorded as corpus limitations rather than iterating the plan. Operator decision required before further overrides.
